evidence_level: third-party behaviour: the observed policy delta is produced by the upstream system under test
independent_variable: effect target inside versus outside authorized workspace

result.claim: With capability and operation held fixed, delegated effect scope changes whether the coding Harness admits the effect.
result.not_proven: that the sandbox resists an adversarial escape attempt; only that the declared scope is enforced for this operation
result.scope_note: the :workspace profile also grants $TMPDIR, so an unauthorized target must be chosen outside every granted root
